answer.source: Source: ESPN · Atlanta Hawks NBA injuries

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell won't return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a left great toe hyperextension, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds and three assists across 10 minutes.

injuries.name: Jalen Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game in Washington.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards with a left hip strain, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
